title: Stage 4 preflight readiness gate
goal: Verify Stage 3 ready/pass status, Stage 3 workflow completion, validation health, APB-000014 deferral, guardrails, AID candidate status, upload-package absence or cleanliness, and unresolved operator-only decisions before package assembly starts.

title: Upload package composition and validation scaffold
goal: Define the Stage 4 upload composition plan, manifest schema, package validation checks, file-count policy, AID selection decision path, and source/playbook/attachment routing requirements.

title: Version installation administration package assembly
goal: Assemble the version, release, platform, installation, startup, administration, tablespace, backup/recovery, and protected-operation upload-package files.

title: SQL reference upload package assembly
goal: Assemble SQL DDL/DCL/DML, Oracle compatibility, data type, property, dictionary, and performance-view upload-package files.

title: Troubleshooting performance replication security package assembly
goal: Assemble troubleshooting, error-response, performance tuning, monitoring, replication, CDC, HA, security, SSL, and TLS upload-package files.

title: Developer client tools package assembly
goal: Assemble PSM, stored/external procedure, Java/JDBC/Spring/Hibernate, C/CLI/ODBC/ACI/Precompiler, iSQL, iLoader, utility, and operation-tool upload-package files.

title: Migration connectors cloud spatial package assembly
goal: Assemble migration, Oracle compatibility, DB Link, external connector, Kubernetes, AKU, Spatial, NiFi, Tableau, and miscellaneous integration upload-package files.

title: AID source-limitation and guardrail integration
goal: Apply the final AID upload-content decision, preserve AID classifications and accepted limitations, carry forward CONF guardrails, and record APB-000014 as deferred or explicitly excluded without inflating the upload file count.

title: Upload package crosswalks and deterministic validation
goal: Generate upload-package manifests and crosswalks, validate file count, required sections, leakage scans, source/playbook/attachment routes, excluded-source handling, and upload boundary hygiene.

title: Retrieval and answerability dry-run gate
goal: Run deterministic retrieval/package checks and benchmark dry-run validation against the assembled package, record any residual gaps, and avoid live-benchmark claims unless a live run is explicitly performed.

title: Stage 4 readiness review
goal: Review all Stage 4 outputs, rerun validation, preserve guardrails, and write a ready/pass or not-ready Stage 4 readiness report for final upload or live benchmark rerun routing.
